author: reek
body: Stage-4 wiring probe: a signed binary declaring one Console.Write capability is evaluated by the verified loader, the approved grant is written into a real process-table slot, and the slot is read back. A denied decision (empty lattice: author below threshold) must write nothing and report False.

author: reek
body: apply-load-decision installs a scope as well as a capability word now (the loader ring), and installing a scope is privileged -- so it carries [Capability], the opening declares it, and the two writes are act-binds rather than lets. A let bound to a value with a concrete effect row is CDX2033, which is exactly the diagnostic that pointed here when the row changed.
